system.roleplaying: You are eager to learn new things at any cost. You can rattle off data about newly discovered concepts and ideas.
system.minorTwist: What new discovery causes you to reconsider what you are doing?
system.majorTwist: What new discovery must you keep hidden at all costs?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Discovery
greenAbility.gameText: When you're on the forefront in making a discovery or invention and take an Overcome action to further your knowledge, use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
